### BlstModule {#BlstModule}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">BlstModule</code></div>

The part of the `@chainsafe/blst` (2.x) module the adapter uses, so the
SDK's types do not depend on it being installed.

```ts sdk-signature
interface BlstModule {
  PublicKey: {
    fromBytes(
      bytes: Uint8Array,
      pkValidate?: boolean,
    ): BlstPublicKey;
  };
  Signature: {
    fromBytes(
      bytes: Uint8Array,
      sigValidate?: boolean,
    ): BlstSignature;
  };
  aggregatePublicKeys(
    keys: BlstPublicKey[],
    pksValidate?: boolean,
  ): BlstPublicKey;
  verify(
    message: Uint8Array,
    publicKey: BlstPublicKey,
    signature: BlstSignature,
  ): boolean;
  verifyMultipleAggregateSignatures(
    sets: Array<{
      msg: Uint8Array;
      pk: BlstPublicKey;
      sig: BlstSignature;
    }>,
  ): boolean;
}
```
